# Poem Camera

> Poem Camera is a camera that doesn't take photos - it takes poems. Point it at the world and an AI writes a short poem about what is in front of you, ready to print.

## Pages

- [Poem Camera](https://poem-camera.happypaul55.com/): what the camera does, its features and how it works.
- [Open the camera](https://poem-camera.happypaul55.com/app): take a frame and have a poem written about it, then print it.
- [Privacy](https://poem-camera.happypaul55.com/privacy): what the camera sends, what it does not store and how the human check works.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/HappyPaul55/poem-camera) - released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0.
- [HappyPaul55](https://www.happypaul55.com/) - the author's site.

## Notes

- The camera stream stays on the device; a single frame is sent to the site's own endpoint, and on to the AI provider, only when a poem is requested.
- Poems can be printed to a Bluetooth thermal receipt printer or an ordinary printer.
- No accounts, no cookies of its own and no analytics; opening the camera runs a Cloudflare Turnstile human check.
